slot.brief: From a list of aqueous ions (including d^0 and d^10 cases), pick which are colourless, coded as 1/2/3/4 combinations.

stem: Consider the aqueous ions: (1) $\text{Sc}^{3+}$, (2) $\text{Y}^{3+}$, (3) $\text{Zn}^{2+}$ and (4) $\text{Cu}^{2+}$. Which set contains all and only the colourless ions?

verdicts.working: Sc³⁺ (d⁰), Y³⁺ (d⁰), and Zn²⁺ (d¹⁰) are colourless; Cu²⁺ (d⁹) is coloured in aqueous solution.

working:
$\text{Sc}^{3+}$ and $\text{Y}^{3+}$ are $d^0$; $\text{Zn}^{2+}$ is $d^{10}$. These ions lack $d$–$d$ transitions and are colourless. $\text{Cu}^{2+}$ is $d^9$ and coloured.

Independent check: Sc³⁺ (d⁰), Y³⁺ (d⁰), and Zn²⁺ (d¹⁰) are colourless; Cu²⁺ (d⁹) is coloured in aqueous solution.
solution:
Ions with $d^0$ or $d^{10}$ configurations lack $d$–$d$ transitions and are colourless.
$\text{Sc}^{3+}:d^0,\text{ Y}^{3+}:d^0,\text{ Zn}^{2+}:d^{10};\text{ Cu}^{2+}:d^9$ is coloured.
Hence the colourless ions are 1, 2 and 3 only.
